content:
People have asked whether Bigfoot exists for decades, and recently, cops in Maine got an answer for at least one mysterious sighting. Read on for more details.

A Police Investigation 

Cops in the state started an investigation after an unusually high number of 911 calls arrived from the small town of Damariscotta. The creature wasn’t hanging out in the woods, though, and seemed particularly brazen because folks reported the strange sighting on Main Street, per UNILAD.

The strange creature was also spotted by people dropping their kids off at school, which probably made for plenty of classroom discussion. But the sheer number of reports obviously needed some verification, and checking them out fell to the police.

Curiosity And Concern 

Damariscotta Police Chief Erik Josephson said, “While walking along Main Street, he certainly attracted attention.”

Josephson also noted, “Some people were concerned and contacted police, while others took the opportunity to stop and take pictures, including while Officer Smith was speaking with him.”

Officer William Smith appears to be a very brave individual, given that he walked over and started chatting with the enormous creature.

Instead of a terrifying experience, Josephson explained that Smith described their interaction as “a great conversation” and found the man “very interesting and understanding when the concerns were explained.”

Not Really A Cryptid?

However, he wasn’t a cryptid and was merely someone wearing a “very convincing costume,” per Dexerto. No criminal charges were filed, so it’s quite possible that folks might never find out who he was.

The Damariscotta Police Department closed the case, but it remains unclear why the man chose to stroll around town in a costume and cause so much concern.

What we do know is that there was no elaborate Bigfoot mystery to unravel. He was just a guy in a fur suit.

The Police Statement

Josephson added, “Ultimately, this is a good example of what we think small-town Maine, and Damariscotta in particular, is all about.”

In the Facebook post, Josephson also noted that, “After a lengthy, exhaustive, and completely serious investigation,” the department could report: “Case closed. Bigfoot remains at large… provided he puts his costume back on.”

As with many unexplained sightings, alongside the apprehension, there’s always plenty of curiosity. It’s no stretch to imagine that some folks secretly hope that one day a real Bigfoot might be discovered and verified.

This time, the police didn’t manage that, and perhaps it’s a little disappointing.

A Caring Community 

The police department seemed pleased with the way people stepped up to keep an eye on each other and look out for their neighbors. They didn’t find a real Bigfoot, but they did find a community willing to make sure everyone was safe.

And honestly, they probably wouldn’t have it any other way.
